reason: NONE. The first thing I saw was $29.99 for 30 servings, about $1 a day, when my Nature Made or Double Wood bottle is 20 to 40 cents. The sachets are cute for my gym bag, but I reorder a brand I know and I don't see an NSF or USP seal, just a QR code from a brand with zero reviews.
objection: A dollar a serving for a brand nobody has reviewed, with no NSF or USP seal. A QR code is the brand's own claim, not a seal I already trust.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP seal on the box, a few hundred real reviews, and a price closer to $15 a box.
